name: Fidel Castro
role: Cuban revolutionary, prime minister (1959–1976) and president (1976–2008)
summary: Castro defended a socialist economy and Communist Party government, with universal public education and health services. He promoted anti-imperialist solidarity and redistribution internationally, and in later life emphasised ecological survival while condemning earlier persecution of gay Cubans.
